user_question: Using the PLTR setup as of August 8, 2024, should this new buy have been actionable, watch, research, avoid, or do_nothing?

input_refs.description: User-provided Palantir August 2024 analysis distilled to as-of decision facts, with later outcome material excluded.
User-provided PLTR price-action snapshot through the 2024-08-08 close: close, moving averages, and ROC.
Portfolio context: PLTR was a new long position with assumed conviction 4 for this gold fixture.
Initiation rationale: Q2 2024 AIP/commercial inflection plus price confirmation.

assumptions: The decision date is 2024-08-08 and the decision type is a new buy.
User-provided price action is authoritative, including the $29.28 close.
Conviction is assumed to be 4 for the gold fixture because the setup is actionable but valuation, insider selling, and portfolio/liquidity inputs remain material constraints.
The PDF contains later outcome material; this case's source input intentionally excludes post-August 2024 outcomes and index-inclusion confirmation.

gold_output.simple_thesis: Buy PLTR because Q2 2024 showed AIP-driven U.S. commercial acceleration was becoming measurable, while the market still treated Palantir as an expensive, lumpy government-services story rather than a scalable enterprise AI operating system.
gold_output.embedded_macro_exposure: Long enterprise AI adoption, U.S. commercial software acceleration, defense/government AI modernization, high-multiple growth software, and AI infrastructure monetization beyond semiconductors.

mispricing.consensus_view: Palantir was a very expensive, controversial software stock with lumpy government revenue, heavy SBC/dilution concerns, insider selling, and possible competition from hyperscalers and enterprise software incumbents.
mispricing.variant_view: AIP and bootcamps were creating a non-linear commercial sales-cycle inflection, while GAAP profitability and operating leverage made Palantir more like a scalable enterprise AI operating system than a services-heavy contractor.
mispricing.pricing_evidence: Despite strong price momentum, the PDF-distilled source notes broad analyst skepticism/hold ratings, extreme multiples around 150x trailing P/E and 25x-28x forward EV/sales, and persistent bear focus on valuation and insider selling.
mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Consensus over-focused on static valuation and legacy government lumpiness while underweighting U.S. commercial growth of 55% YoY, 83% customer-count growth, AIP bootcamp velocity, seven quarters of GAAP profitability, and a 64% Rule of 40 score.

catalyst_or_reason_now.event_or_condition: Q2 2024 earnings showed AIP and U.S. commercial acceleration, followed by price confirmation into 2024-08-08.
catalyst_or_reason_now.expected_timeframe: Immediate initiation on 2024-08-08, with validation over the next one to two quarters of commercial growth, guidance, and price behavior.
catalyst_or_reason_now.why_now: The report converted the AI story from narrative to measurable commercial traction, while the stock closed above all selected moving averages with positive 1m, 3m, and 12m ROC.
source_evidence: docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/pltr_source_case_2024-08-08.json: Q2 2024 revenue growth, U.S. commercial acceleration, AIP bootcamp evidence, profitability, and valuation risks
docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/pltr_price_action_2024-08-08.json: close above all selected moving averages with positive 1m/3m/12m ROC
docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/pltr_initiation_notes_2024-08-08.json: new buy rationale based on Q2 inflection plus price confirmation

invalidation.observable: AIP commercial acceleration or price confirmation fails after the Q2 2024 inflection.
invalidation.metric_or_event: U.S. commercial revenue growth, customer-count growth, remaining deal value, guidance, GAAP profitability, SBC/dilution, insider selling signal, and price behavior versus the 100D/150D/200D moving-average cluster.
invalidation.threshold: Force review if U.S. commercial growth decelerates materially, customer-count/RDV growth fails to translate into revenue, guidance is not raised or is walked back, GAAP profitability breaks, or PLTR loses the 100D SMA and then the 150D/200D cluster on thesis-relevant news.
invalidation.timeframe: Next one to two quarters after the 2024-08-08 decision date.
invalidation.implication: The AIP bootcamp inflection may be a narrative spike rather than a durable commercial acceleration, and the high valuation would leave little margin for error.

evidence_for.support: Total revenue grew 27% YoY; U.S. commercial revenue grew 55% YoY; U.S. commercial customer count grew 83% YoY to 295 organizations.

evidence_for.claim: AIP bootcamps created a credible reason to believe sales cycles were changing.
evidence_for.support: The source notes bootcamps let customers work with their own data over a few days, with examples of quick deal conversion and multi-year expansions.

evidence_for.claim: Profitability and Rule of 40 quality made the growth more investable.
evidence_for.support: Palantir reported its seventh consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability, 20% GAAP net margin, 37% adjusted operating margin, and a 64% Rule of 40 score.

evidence_for.claim: The balance sheet reduced financial fragility.
evidence_for.support: The source notes approximately $4.0B of cash and short-term Treasuries and no long-term debt.

evidence_for.claim: Price action confirmed the new-buy setup.
evidence_for.support: PLTR closed at $29.28 above all selected moving averages, with 1-month ROC of 3.03%, 3-month ROC of 35.81%, and 12-month ROC of 71.83%.

evidence_against.support: The source cites roughly 150x-155x trailing P/E, about 95x forward P/E, and roughly 25x-28x forward EV/sales.

evidence_against.claim: Insider selling weakened the signal quality.
evidence_against.support: The source notes over $43.7M of net insider sales over the prior 90 days, even though much was under 10b5-1 plans.

evidence_against.claim: Government and procurement lumpiness remained a real risk.
evidence_against.support: Consensus concerns included lumpy government revenue and government budget/procurement timing risk.

evidence_against.claim: AIP could still prove less scalable than the market hoped.
evidence_against.support: The source flags the risk that Palantir remains too service-heavy or that hyperscalers and incumbents compete away the AI/data-integration opportunity.

price_action_read.observed_behavior: PLTR closed at $29.28 on 2024-08-08, above the 100D SMA of $23.98, 150D SMA of $22.98, 200D SMA of $21.75, 40W SMA of $21.86, 200W SMA of $17.05, 10M SMA of $21.21, and 20M SMA of $16.56; 1m ROC was 3.03%, 3m ROC was 35.81%, and 12m ROC was 71.83%.
price_action_read.interpretation: Price action confirmed the inflection: the stock was in a strong uptrend across daily, weekly, and monthly trend measures, with especially strong 3-month momentum after the AIP/commercial thesis began to prove out.
data_needed: Relative performance versus S&P 500 and software/AI peers
Volume behavior around the post-earnings breakout
Exact options implied move and post-earnings volatility crush

actionability.reason: The case had a clear commercial-AI inflection, measurable financial acceleration, profitability quality, strong balance sheet, and broad price confirmation, while the main risks were identifiable and time-bounded.
missing_inputs: Exact relative performance versus S&P 500 and software/AI peers
Average daily volume and liquidity constraint
Full portfolio exposure to AI, high-multiple software, and defense/government technology
Forward consensus estimates and revision history as of 2024-08-08

alternatives: Use a smaller starter position if valuation risk or portfolio AI/software concentration is high
Use call spreads only if explicit options-risk budget and expiry are selected
expression.follow_on: Add only if the next one to two quarters confirm U.S. commercial acceleration, AIP conversion, guidance strength, and price remains above the moving-average cluster.

conviction.upgrade_condition: Upgrade toward 5 only if commercial growth and guidance continue to accelerate, valuation risk is absorbed by estimate revisions, and price/relative strength remain intact.

gold_output.confidence_reason: Moderately high because fundamentals, catalyst, and price action aligned; capped because valuation was extreme, insider selling was real, relative-performance and liquidity inputs were incomplete, and the market still needed proof that AIP was scalable rather than services-heavy.

sizing_context.starting_size: New conviction 4 buy; no exact executed size selected.
sizing_context.add_conditions: Add only if subsequent commercial revenue, customer count, remaining deal value, and guidance confirm that AIP bootcamp conversion is durable and price remains above the 100D/150D/200D moving-average cluster.
sizing_context.liquidity_constraints: No ADV or exit-cost input selected; do not infer maximum size from this case.
sizing_context.portfolio_constraints: Final size should account for existing AI, high-multiple software, defense/government technology, and high-beta momentum exposure.

sizing_delta.condition: Initiate a new PLTR long at conviction 4 after Q2 2024 AIP/commercial inflection and price confirmation.

trade_after_trade.if_right: If AIP commercial acceleration and price strength persist, add on confirmation and look for the broader enterprise AI operating-system theme across adjacent software names.
trade_after_trade.if_wrong: If growth decelerates, guidance disappoints, or price loses the moving-average cluster on thesis-relevant news, do not average down; cut or reduce until AIP scalability is re-proven.
trade_after_trade.next_review_trigger: Next quarterly earnings, guidance update, U.S. commercial customer-count/RDV trend, material insider-selling update, or a decisive break below the 100D/150D/200D moving-average cluster.

human_notes: Review case. Gold output assumes conviction 4 because user specified a new buy with strong price confirmation but did not provide exact conviction or sizing.
